topic: Agree or disagree: Governments should do more to address the problem of social isolation.

passage:
In recent years, some supermarkets have stopped using plastic packaging for fresh food. Instead, fruits and vegetables are sold loose, and customers are encouraged to bring their own bags and containers. These stores say that the change has reduced their plastic waste dramatically and has attracted environmentally conscious shoppers.

There are also financial benefits. Because the stores no longer need to buy large amounts of packaging, they can save money, and some have passed these savings on to customers through lower prices. In addition, selling products loose allows shoppers to buy exactly the amount they need, which helps to reduce food waste at home.

However, the approach has drawbacks. Without packaging, some fresh products spoil more quickly, which can increase waste in the stores themselves. Some customers also find it inconvenient to bring their own containers, especially when they shop on the way home from work. For these reasons, critics argue that plastic-free shopping will remain limited to a small number of shoppers unless supermarkets find ways to make it more convenient.
